lore: The archive atolls sit on a great ring of tide markers. Each save rests on the first atoll marker the current carries it to, sailing clockwise. Through the storm season atolls rise from the sea and others sink beneath it, and the ferries must carry their saves to wherever the current now leads. Plant one marker per atoll and the current piles saves onto the unlucky ones; renumber the whole ring each time and the ferries never stop.

lines.start: Twelve hundred saves on the ring and the season's already turning. Keep the ferries light and no atoll overloaded.
lines.rise: A new atoll's up out of the sea. Only the saves just before its markers sail over to it.
lines.sink: That atoll's going under. Its saves drift on to the next markers along the current.
lines.win: Every atoll rose and sank and the ferries barely broke a sweat. Every save is right where the ring says.
lines.fail: The ferries are swamped or one atoll's sinking under the load. Plant your markers better.
